result.title: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See
result.summary: Despite the success of video world models, extending them to multiple agents is difficult because it requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent in time and between agents. To address this gap, we introduce OverSeer, a multi-agent world model that augments egocentric agent views with auxiliary camera views. We suggest that, by fixing the auxiliary views in space, they act as a proxy for a world-centric representation: Unlike the agents' views, which can change entirely due to a simple change in agent position, changes in the auxiliary views directly map to localized changes in the world state. We show that these fixed views substantially help the model to maintain consistency. We also show that, due to their redundant and semi-static nature, the auxiliary views can be efficiently compressed with a delta-VAE that encodes only the changes relative to a static reference image, reducing the number of tokens required to process them. Experiments in Minecraft and Doom demonstrate improved world and agent consistency, with qualitative results on real-world multi-camera captures indicating that the approach is not tied to game engines. Our compression analysis further shows that delta-VAE substantially reduces the computational overhead of auxiliary-view generation. We conclude that these fixed views provide a simple and efficient way to improve multi-agent world models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出多智能体视频世界模型 OverSeer：在自视视角之外引入空间固定的辅助相机视角，作为世界中心表示的代理以提升时间与智能体间一致性，并用只编码相对静态参考图变化的 delta-VAE 压缩这些冗余视角、降低 token 与计算开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 固定辅助视角提供脱离自我中心、可持久的视觉状态，delta-VAE 的增量编码可能为 LVR 中长期视觉证据的缓存压缩与状态更新成本提供可供核查的方法线索，但该文属视频世界模型，与 latent 推理无直接关联。
